questions.question: What is the area (in square units) of the triangle formed by the graphs of the equations: 2x - y + 8 = 0 and 8x + 3y - 24 = 0, and y = 0?
questions.solution: The problem asks for the area of the triangle bounded by the lines 2x - y + 8 = 0, 8x + 3y - 24 = 0, and y = 0 (the x-axis).

questions.question: A solid wooden toy is in the shape of a right circular cone mounted on a hemisphere. If the radius of the hemisphere is 5.6 cm and the total height of the toy is 11.6 cm, then what is the volume of the wooden toy (in cm3) (rounded off to the closest integral value)?
questions.solution: Volume of toy = Volume of cone + Volume of hemisphere. Radius (r) = 5.6 cm. Height of hemisphere = 5.6 cm. Height of cone = 11.6 - 5.6 = 6 cm. Volume = (1/3 * 22/7 * 5.6 * 5.6 * 6) + (2/3 * 22/7 * 5.6 * 5.6 * 5.6) = 197.12 + 367.92 = 565.04 cm³.

questions.question: The ratio of the outer and the inner circumference of a circular path is 17 : 15. If path is 40 metres wide, then what is the radius of the inner circle?
questions.solution: Let the radius of outer circle be R and inner circle be r. Given ratio of circumference = 2πR / 2πr = 17/15. So, R/r = 17/15. Given width (R - r) = 40m. Let R = 17x, r = 15x. Then 17x - 15x = 40 => 2x = 40 => x = 20. Inner radius r = 15 * 20 = 300 metres.

questions.question: The whole surface area of a pyramid whose base is a regular polygon is 260 cm² and the area of its base is 120 cm². The area of each lateral face is 20 cm². Then the number of lateral faces is:
questions.solution: Total surface area = Lateral surface area + Area of Base. 260 = Lateral surface area + 120 => Lateral surface area = 140. Number of faces = 140 / 20 = 7.

questions.question: In △ABC, ∠B = 90° and BD ⊥ AC. If AC = 9 cm and AD = 3 cm, then BD is equal to:
questions.solution: In a right-angled triangle, if BD is the altitude to the hypotenuse AC, then BD² = AD × DC. Given AC = 9 and AD = 3, then DC = 6. BD² = 3 × 6 = 18. BD = √18 = 3√2 cm. (Note: Based on standard geometric properties for this problem, 3√2 cm is the correct derived value).

questions.question: A cylindrical hole with the radius of its base given as 3.5 cm is made in a solid cube each of whose edge is 14 cm. Find the total surface area (in cm²) of the cube with the hole. [Use π = 22/7]
questions.solution: Total surface area of the cube = 6 * side² = 6 * 14 * 14 = 1176. Area of circular hole = πr² = 22/7 * 3.5 * 3.5 = 38.5. Surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh = 2 * 22/7 * 3.5 * 14 = 308. Total Surface Area = (Surface Area of Cube - 2 * Area of Circle) + Lateral Surface Area of Cylinder = (1176 - 2 * 38.5) + 308 = (1176 - 77) + 308 = 1099 + 308 = 1407 cm².

questions.question: A thief was spotted by a policeman from a distance of 225 metres. When the policeman started the chase, the thief also started running. If the speed of the thief was 11 km/h and that of the policeman was 13 km/h, how far would the thief have run, before the policeman caught up with him ?
questions.solution: Relative speed = 13 - 11 = 2 km/h = 2 * (5/18) m/s = 5/9 m/s. Time to catch the thief = Distance / Relative speed = 225 / (5/9) = 225 * 9 / 5 = 405 seconds. Distance covered by thief = Speed of thief * Time = 11 * (5/18) * 405 = 11 * 5 * 22.5 = 1237.5 metres.

questions.question: Ramesh purchases 75 articles for ₹ 10800 and sells them at a loss equal to the selling price of 5 articles. What will be the selling price of one article?
questions.solution: Cost price of 75 articles = 10800. Selling price of 75 articles = SP_75. Loss = CP - SP = 10800 - SP_75. Given loss = 5 * SP_1. So, 5 * SP_1 = 10800 - 75 * SP_1. 80 * SP_1 = 10800. SP_1 = 10800 / 80 = 135.

questions.question: Three friends A, B, C invested in a business in the ratio of 3 : 2 : 6. After 6 months C withdraw half his capital. If the total profit earned for the year is Rs.53010 (in Rs.). Then Profit made by A is
questions.solution: Ratio of investment: A=3, B=2, C=6. For 1 year: A invests 3 units for 12 months = 36. B invests 2 units for 12 months = 24. C invests 6 units for 6 months + 3 units for 6 months = 36 + 18 = 54. Profit ratio = 36:24:54 = 6:4:9. Total units = 6+4+9 = 19. Total profit = 53010. Profit of A = (6/19) * 53010 = 6 * 2790 = 16740.
